title: A better next step
captions: burned-in with an optional English text track

scenes.title: A better story begins
scenes.narration: A kettle stops working. A laptop sits forgotten. Then a child asks: does this have to become rubbish? For one family, a better story begins.

scenes.title: One place. Two ways to begin.
scenes.narration: Meet FixForward. One place to understand everyday electronics and make thoughtful choices about e-waste. Start by learning together, or get help with an item.

scenes.title: Make curiosity visible
scenes.narration: Turn a digital appliance around. Discover what its parts do, and explore simple care habits. Big ideas become something your family can see.

scenes.title: Learn the reason behind a choice
scenes.narration: Now, try a choice. This working laptop has been checked by an adult. Repair, reuse, or recycle? Reuse could give it another chapter. Every answer explains why.

scenes.title: Start with the item
scenes.narration: For a real item, an adult takes the lead. Choose its category, or try the optional photo helper where available. It suggests a type, not a diagnosis.

scenes.title: Ask the important questions
scenes.narration: Consider warning signs and check recall information before choosing your next step. Children can spot questions to ask. Adults handle real appliances and arrange qualified help.

scenes.title: Find a useful next step
scenes.narration: Explore repair when suitable, reuse when an item is safe and wanted, or appropriate recycling. Check the service and what it accepts before visiting.

scenes.title: A habit worth sharing
scenes.narration: Back at home, the conversation changes. Let's find out before we throw it away. A small discovery becomes a useful habit, shared across the family.

scenes.title: Little discoveries. Better choices.
scenes.narration: FixForward. Little discoveries. Better choices. Learn together, or get help with an item. A better next step starts here.
